verdict.rationale: The firm's own venture capital practice page says it advises companies through funding rounds "ultimately through to an exit (including M&A transactions, secondary buyouts and IPOs)". Its TwoVenture hub has an "Exit & Beyond" section. However, this rests on a single sentence and a section heading rather than documented exit experience. Missing for 10: dedicated M&A or capital-markets/IPO practice pages, concrete exit deal examples or volumes for venture-backed companies, detail on the Exit & Beyond guidance, and independent corroboration.
